triad.description: The Generator rejected a valid socioeconomic entity containing an educational attainment marker by over-applying demographic exclusion rules to gender-qualified terms.

guidebook.guideline: Distinguish compound population descriptors containing explicit educational attainment or enrollment markers from purely demographic exclusions. When a candidate span pairs a demographic qualifier (such as gender or age) with an indicator of educational standing (e.g., 'college students'), classify the span under Socioeconomic_factors based on the substantive educational attribute rather than rejecting it as demographic noise.
